title: Music in the Parks
theme: Park songs, parade music and area music
intro: [excited] Turn it up! Tonight's board is all about the music of the Disney parks: ride songs, barbershop quartets, area music and those earworms you hum all the way home. [laughs] You're welcome in advance.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A theme park main street at twilight with a bandstand gazebo, a gramophone horn, floating musical notes made of light over a castle silhouette made of abstract spires, warm string lights.

categories.title: Practically Perfect
categories.intro: Our film category is Mary Poppins! Spoonfuls of sugar, singing chimney sweeps and the songwriting brothers who also wrote some of the parks' biggest hits.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A London rooftop at dusk with chimneys, a black umbrella with a carved bird handle floating above them, a carpet bag on the tiles and kites in the sky.

clues.clue: In Mary Poppins, this super-long word is something to say when you don't know what to say.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is supercalifragilisticexpialidocious! [laughs] If you spelled it right on your phone, I'm a little scared of you.

clues.clue: This actor played Bert, the chimney sweep, and also the old bank chairman in Mary Poppins.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dick Van Dyke! [chuckles] He played two parts in one movie, and that accent is still talked about today.

clues.clue: Feed the Birds, Walt Disney's favourite song, is about a woman who sells breadcrumbs for this price per bag.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is tuppence! [sighs] Walt would ask Richard Sherman to play Feed the Birds for him on Friday afternoons. Beautiful.

clues.clue: Mary Poppins' talking umbrella has a handle carved in the shape of this kind of bird.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a parrot! [laughs] A talking parrot head umbrella. And it's sassier than most people.

clues.clue: The Sherman Brothers wrote Mary Poppins and it's a small world. Name both brothers.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Richard and Robert Sherman! They also wrote the Tiki Room song and There's a Great Big Beautiful Tomorrow. Park legends.

categories.title: Soundtrack of the Rides
categories.intro: Next up, Soundtrack of the Rides! Every great ride has a great tune. Let's see who's been listening.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Vintage gramophone horns poking out of a dark ride tunnel, glowing musical notes floating along a ride track, a little ride car waiting at the entrance.

clues.clue: You can fly! You can fly! You can fly! plays as you soar over London on this Fantasyland dark ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Peter Pan's Flight! [laughs] It opened with Disneyland in 1955, and the line has been long ever since.

clues.clue: On Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, the dwarfs sing this song as they work in the diamond mine.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Heigh-Ho! [chuckles] It's home from work we go... at about 34 miles per hour.

clues.clue: In the Country Bear Jamboree, this huge, lazy-voiced bear strums his guitar and sings Blood on the Saddle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Big Al! [laughs] He can't sing, he can't play, and fans absolutely adore him. Relatable.

clues.clue: This legendary composer of Star Trek and Alien scores wrote the soaring music for Soarin'.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Jerry Goldsmith! The Soarin' theme is one of the most beloved pieces of park music. [sighs] Smell the oranges!

clues.clue: Miracles from Molecules was the theme song of this Tomorrowland ride, where guests shrank smaller than a snowflake from 1967 to 1985.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Adventure Thru Inner Space! It closed in 1985 and Star Tours moved into the space. [chuckles] Fans still miss it.

categories.title: Name That Music Spot
categories.intro: Picture category! These are real photos from the Disney parks. Each one is all about the music. Tell me what you're looking at.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A collage of vintage postcards on a corkboard showing abstract theme park scenes: a white spired facade, a bandstand, a giant guitar shape and tiki torches, no text.

clues.clue: Name this boat ride, famous for one very catchy song.
accept: it's a small world after all
clues.reveal: The correct answer is it's a small world! [laughs] And now it's stuck in your head for the rest of the day. Sorry. Not sorry.

clues.clue: This giant guitar marks a Hollywood Studios coaster that opened in 1999 starring this rock band.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aerosmith! [excited] Rock 'n' Roller Coaster launches you from zero to about 57 miles an hour, with Aerosmith blasting in your ears.

clues.clue: Name this singing group, which has entertained Main Street, U.S.A. guests since the 1950s.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Dapper Dans! [chuckles] Four-part harmony, striped vests and straw hats. Barbershop never goes out of style.

source.author: HarshLight from San Jose, CA, USA

clues.clue: Name this World Showcase pavilion, where the Voices of Liberty sing in the rotunda.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The American Adventure! Benjamin Franklin and Mark Twain host the show inside. [excited] The a cappella Voices of Liberty sing in the lobby.

clues.clue: These tiki drummers play in this 1963 Disneyland show, the first to use Audio-Animatronics.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room! In the tiki tiki tiki tiki tiki room! [laughs] I'll stop. Maybe.

categories.title: Strike Up the Band
categories.intro: Parks time! The parks are full of live musicians. [excited] Name who's playing and where.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunny park plaza with an empty bandstand, a polished upright piano, a stack of plastic trash cans used as drums, a pair of maracas and a large taiko drum.

clues.clue: At Casey's Corner on Magic Kingdom's Main Street, a ragtime musician plays this instrument.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the piano! [chuckles] Ragtime with your hot dog. Main Street knows how to live.

clues.clue: Mariachi Cobre is a mariachi band that performs at this World Showcase pavilion at EPCOT.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mexico! [excited] Mariachi Cobre has been playing at EPCOT since the early 1980s. Olé!

clues.clue: This EPCOT group of custodians turns trash cans and buckets into a percussion show.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the JAMMitors! [laughs] The only band where the drums need to be emptied after the show.

clues.clue: At EPCOT's Japan pavilion, Matsuriza performers play these traditional giant Japanese drums.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is taiko drums! [excited] You don't just hear Matsuriza, you feel it in your chest. BOOM!

clues.clue: This Disneyland marching band has played on Main Street, U.S.A. since opening day in 1955.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Disneyland Band! [chuckles] Walt hired them for two weeks in 1955, and they never really left.

categories.title: Background Music
categories.intro: Our fan category is Background Music! Every land has its own area music playing through hidden speakers. Name the land, or the music.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A theme park pathway with a fake rock hiding a small speaker, flowers and a bench, musical notes drifting through the trees, hazy morning light.

clues.clue: At Hollywood Studios, peppy toy-box versions of You've Got a Friend in Me play in this land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Toy Story Land! [laughs] You're the size of a toy in Andy's backyard, so the music is playful.

clues.clue: Futuristic, synth-heavy area music hums through this Magic Kingdom land, home of Space Mountain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tomorrowland! [chuckles] The future, as imagined by people with lots of synthesisers.

clues.clue: Banjos, fiddles and cowboy tunes fill this land, home of Big Thunder Mountain Railroad.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frontierland! Yee-haw! [laughs] It's the wildest music in the wilderness.

clues.clue: Fife-and-drum and colonial-era music plays in this Magic Kingdom land, home of the Hall of Presidents.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Liberty Square! [chuckles] It's 1776 and the music is very patriotic. Ben Franklin would approve.

clues.clue: This legendary Star Wars composer wrote an original new theme for Galaxy's Edge when it opened in 2019.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is John Williams! He wrote the Galaxy's Edge Symphonic Suite. [gasps] The man who wrote the Star Wars theme, writing for a theme park!
